text_en: As for you, Vanij, you will use your powers of alchemy to hide your true form and will become a guide to this new world.
You will a build a city, a symbol of the unity between the peoples of this universe and, in it, you will host all of the souls you receive, making sure that they know never to search for me.
Vanij, you will become a beacon of hope for hundreds of thousands. I know that you are up to the task.
